omission_reason: Administrative conversation note; scientific protocol fields unchanged

protocol.validation_type: Author-prepared prospective parameter-hidden holdout, not independent human blinding
protocol.purpose: Test the revised population-first rules on a fixed new set; separate stochastic-update setting effects before interpreting output changes.

bridge.changed_setting: Set every vType sigmaStep=1.0 s; retain the saved 0.1/0.1 s ballistic configuration and its other input parameters.
bridge.interpretation: Within-setting paired bridge, not numerical convergence or proof of a junction defect. Output-only FCD recording may be omitted; traffic dynamics and warning policies remain unchanged.

holdout.setting: SUMO 1.24.0; step/action=0.1/0.1 s; explicit sigmaStep=1.0 s for all vehicle types; ballistic; junction collision checks on; collision teleport; gridlock teleport 300 s; one-hour fixed cohort; no warmup exclusion.
holdout.setting_rationale: Preserve the original 1 s Krauss stochastic-update period explicitly while using compatible fine integration/action intervals. Fixed before new outcomes, not selected for fewer warnings. This is the setting of this holdout, not a claim that all manuscript settings are converged.
holdout.scope: Assumed within-model scenarios. The timing-audit control deliberately sets tau=0.08 s below the 0.1 s step/action; retain and qualify it, not a physically recommended parameter.
holdout.labels: Construction families are known applied inputs, not realized causal truth. Do not calculate causal accuracy, confusion or valid-gain recall without separately justified reference judgments.
holdout.local: 53 monitored controlled lanes partitioned into target (5), donor (13), and remaining lanes. Count lane-end front entries; sum duration-weighted mean maximum jam extent over last up-to-100 m. Fixed grouping, including donor costs, is used for all cases.
holdout.groups_source: The six-second reallocation has the same receiving/donating movement sets as the prior four-second candidate; cycle, states, offsets and clearances are unchanged.
holdout.recovery_target: target aggregate only; not a claim that each of the five target lanes improves
holdout.seed_unit: Five paired seeds per case; 12 scenario units, 60 treatment simulations and 5 shared references. Seeds are not independent causal cases.
holdout.outcome_reporting: All seven rule variants and all cases, warnings, abstentions and mixed flags; no post-outcome replacement, favorable-seed selection or threshold tuning.

protocol.stopping: Stop scheduling new runs on a process, input-integrity or population-accounting error; finish and preserve already running jobs. A completed warning-exposed run is not a failed run. Never overwrite partial run folders.
